hypothesis: When funding is unusually large, traders on the crowded side close before the 00/08/16 UTC print to avoid paying it and reopen after, so price reverses toward the crowded side after the print: entering at print + 1 min in the crowded side's direction (long if funding > 0) beats side-matched random twins over the next 4 hours.
mechanism: Funding-avoidance round trip around the settlement timestamp: pre-print selling by longs (or buying by shorts) depresses (lifts) price into the print; re-entry after the print restores it. Distinct from C2 (multi-day funding fade) and K-series (OI, taker flow, DVOL).
closed_ideas_check: Not on research_loop/CLOSED_IDEAS.md (crypto rows: K1 Coinbase premium, K2 OI momentum, K3 taker flow, K4 DVOL regime). C2 multi-day funding fade lives in the MFP study (train only, not closed as a family on this horizon). Spend ledger: no one_look on crypto for these families.
data_choice: Binance UM realized funding prints (time, funding_rate) via Features.funding (avail = print time). Predicted funding is not on disk; the rate fixed AT the print is known at the print and used as the 'last' rate the plan allows.

rules.print: each funding print time T (floored to the minute, P); the 1m bar starting at P must exist and not be stale.
rules.threshold: Q = q-quantile of |rate| over the prints in [P - 30 days, P) (prior prints only), needing >= 80 of them. Signal when |rate(P)| > Q STRICTLY (many prints sit at the 0.0001 default; with ties a '>=' rule would fire on most prints whenever Q equals the default).
rules.entry: Signal on the 1m bar starting at P (decided at P + 60 s, when the rate is known); entry at the next bar's open = print + 1 min.
rules.bracket: stop = target = 1.5% of the decision bar's close (1R).
rules.exit: time exit at print + 4h (end = last 1m bar starting before P + 4h).

count_check: Before the run, count signals per asset from the strategy's signals() on train (no outcomes, logged as a count-only train look); a config under 200 on BTC or ETH is dropped and not replaced (F4/F5 precedent).
expected_sign: positive mean net R on BTC and ETH; not weaker at q=0.95 than at q=0.80.
against_the_mechanism: Mechanism check (measured, not traded, report only): on the qualifying prints, the 60-minute return into the print (bar P-60 open to bar P-1 close) signed by -side must be positive on average (price drifts AGAINST the crowded side into the print). If it is <= 0 on both assets, the pre-print avoidance flow is absent and any post-print effect is not this mechanism.
